scope: Scoped new results only; no full-target resolution and no catalog writeback.

results.statement: For every n, line-free admissible two-colour remainders in F_3^n are exactly the empty set, a singleton, two points, or an affine parallelogram.
Full fibres inherit admissibility for any k over odd prime fields. For two colours the number of complete parallel maximal flats is 1, 2, or 4, with parallelogram quotient structure for four.
For k>=2, n>=k ceil(log_3(10k))+2, there is an admissible density-1/10 partition with largest affine dimension exactly n-k-2.
The epsilon log(1/epsilon) coefficient of the ratio under adding an atom is [2u_minus-1-rho(2u_plus-1)]/Delta_plus; for rho>1 only (A+A-A)\A can give positive leading coefficients.
A finite real law of ratio >1 cannot be globally extremal if it fully occupies an arithmetic progression, or if either support endpoint has probability >=1/2.
The displayed twelve-point rational law has ratio 1.4051810329220149462009831947934829507300... and proves C_*>14051810329/10^10.
